injections.name: ONLY_OTHER_EVENTS_HEADING
injections.what: the heading pattern requires 'Other Events' right after 'Item 8.01', which is what the first extraction did

injections.name: ALIASES_FROM_THE_WHOLE_DOCUMENT
injections.what: aliases_in_the_8_01_item computed over the whole document

injections.name: ANY_AGREEING_READING_IS_A_MATCH
injections.what: a position is MATCH when one reading gives the published count, which would accept Lumen, Macy's and Marriott on the reading still to be decided

injections.name: HEADER_COUNT_ACCEPTS_E01_AGAIN
injections.what: the register accepts E01 from event-count-read.json's header count again
injections.how: bluntly: the two readings both grant Enphase, Ford and Southwest, and the builder refuses with ACCEPTANCE_ID_NOT_UNIQUE. Were the header reading to grant a position the 8.01 reading does not hold, only the committed-register comparison would see it.

injections.name: JUDGED_READING_IGNORES_THE_ALIAS
injections.what: the judged reading counts any item judged to report a transaction, alias or not
injections.note: no 8.01 in these windows reports a transaction without an alias, so no committed count moves under it; the case is built.

restored: both files compared byte for byte with their copies after the last injection
